title: SEC1: Add oracle drift mitigation plan for sieve-rs updates
description:
The cross-validation test (tests/cross_validate.rs) uses sieve-rs as an oracle. If sieve-rs upstream fixes a bug or changes behavior, the cross-validation test will fail.

Scenario: sieve-rs v0.8 is released and fixes a variable substitution bug. The cross-validation test fails. Which implementation is correct?

Current state: No documented procedure for resolving oracle divergence. A solo maintainer without Sieve expertise cannot reliably determine correctness by reading RFC 5228/5229.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add section to CLAUDE.md: 'Sieve-rs Oracle Divergence Protocol'
  - What to do when cross-validation fails
  - When to pin sieve-rs version vs. update sieve-native
  - How to consult external references (RFC, Dovecot, etc.)
- Document current sieve-rs version (0.7) and why it was chosen
- (Optional) Add external reference test vectors from Dovecot Sieve test suite
